card.name: Inside interaction and exposure phrases
card.fires_on: Partway through phrases in drug-interaction text, such as the UC in AUC, the second ug in drug-drug, or an increase verb right after AUC. It also fires on a few other medical phrase pieces, such as tourniquet and mixed with.
